metadata.title: A five-list obstruction on an eleven-vertex tree
metadata.description:
We exhibit an eleven-vertex tree T with ordinary L(2,1) initial-segment palette size 5 (zero-based span 4) and arbitrary-list parameter 6. An explicit assignment of five-element positive-integer lists is infeasible by a short forcing argument. An ordinary five-palette labeling and the known Delta+3 tree list bound give the exact values. This contradicts the universal equality stated as Conjecture4 in Kohl's 2006 Oberwolfach contribution and Conjecture4.4 in her dissertation. Independently chosen outward pendant-path extensions give infinitely many examples of unbounded diameter.

The known tree bound and Fiala–Škrekovski's 2001 cyclic general-graph five-list obstruction are credited. A bounded source audit leaves historical priority and present openness unestablished; no firstness, minimal-order or new-mechanism claim is made. The deposit includes a three-page research note and a portable TeX-source, exact-verification and priority-audit archive. AI tools were used extensively in research, proof development, literature review, computation, internal adversarial verification and writing. This preprint is unrefereed; no external human peer review or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed.
